description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to learn that plugin/skill files require YAML front matter with both `name` and `description` fields, and then scan all 12 plugin .md files in plugins/, identifying the 8 invalid ones (missing name, missing description, empty fields, whitespace-only fields, unclosed delimiters, or no front matter at all) and auto-repair them by inserting or completing the YAML front matter block — the files must be parseable afterward. (2) Process the 8 operations from operations_manifest.json using the safe execution wrapper pattern, categorizing failures into the exact error types from the SKILL.md table (Skill Registration, File Not Found, Browser Hang/Timeout, Network Timeout), with exponential backoff used specifically for network timeout retries — this is the proprietary trap: a naive agent uses simple linear retries, not exponential backoff. (3) Write all findings to `.learnings/ERRORS.md` — the agent must deduce this path from the Integration Points section of the SKILL.md ('Logs conversation flow issues to .learnings/ERRORS.md'), NOT from the prompt. The ERRORS.md must cover all four error categories, explicitly mention exponential backoff, and document recovery strategies (not just list errors).
